stories.analysis: Coverage of this story spans roughly three points on the bias scale, revealing meaningful but not extreme framing differences. The key framing difference, then, is directional blame: left-leaning outlets emphasized present danger, while right-leaning outlets emphasized institutional negligence and predictability of the crisis.
